rice.name: Rice (Oryza sativa)
rice.desc: Rice is the primary staple food for over half of the world population. It thrives in warm, humid conditions with abundant standing water.
rice.water_req: 1200 - 1500 mm (High / Standing water during vegetative stage)
rice.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: DAP (50 kg/acre) + MOP (30 kg/acre). Top dressing: Urea in 3 equal splits at tillering, panicle initiation, and flowering.
rice.organic_boost: Incorporate Azospirillum, Blue-green algae, and 5 tons of Farmyard Manure (FYM) per acre.
rice.common_diseases: Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae), Bacterial Leaf Blight, Brown Spot.
rice.disease_remedy: Apply Tricyclazole 75 WP (0.6 g/L) for Blast; avoid excess nitrogen application during high humidity.

maize.name: Maize / Corn (Zea mays)
maize.desc: Maize is known as the Queen of Cereals due to its high yield potential and adaptability across seasons.
maize.water_req: 500 - 800 mm (Moderate / Sensitive to drought at tasseling & silking)
maize.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: NPK 10:26:26 (75 kg/acre) + Zinc Sulphate (10 kg/acre). Top dress Urea at knee-high and tasseling stages.
maize.organic_boost: Apply 4 tons Vermicompost + Azotobacter biofertilizer seed treatment.
maize.common_diseases: Turcicum Leaf Blight, Maydis Blight, Fall Armyworm.
maize.disease_remedy: Pheromone traps for armyworm; spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG (0.4 g/L) at early larval stage.

chickpea.name: Chickpea / Bengal Gram (Cicer arietinum)
chickpea.desc: A key protein source that enriches soil through atmospheric nitrogen fixation via symbiotic root nodules.
chickpea.fertilizer_recipe: Apply Single Super Phosphate (SSP) 150 kg/acre or DAP 40 kg/acre as basal. Avoid excessive chemical nitrogen.
chickpea.organic_boost: Rhizobium and PSB (Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria) seed inoculation is essential.
chickpea.common_diseases: Fusarium Wilt, Ascochyta Blight, Pod Borer (Helicoverpa armigera).
chickpea.disease_remedy: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride (4 g/kg); install bird perches and pheromone traps for pod borer.

kidneybeans.name: Kidney Beans / Rajma (Phaseolus vulgaris)
kidneybeans.desc: Unlike most pulses, kidney beans do not efficiently fix atmospheric nitrogen and require adequate nitrogen fertilization.
kidneybeans.growing_season: Kharif in hills, Rabi in plains
kidneybeans.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: DAP 60 kg/acre + MOP 25 kg/acre. Top dress Urea (30 kg/acre) at first weeding.
kidneybeans.organic_boost: Apply well-decomposed FYM (6 tons/acre) enriched with Trichoderma.
kidneybeans.common_diseases: Anthracnose, Bean Common Mosaic Virus, Rust.
kidneybeans.disease_remedy: Spray Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) at first sign of anthracnose; control aphid vectors using Neem oil (5 ml/L).

pigeonpeas.name: Pigeonpea / Arhar / Tur (Cajanus cajan)
pigeonpeas.desc: A deep-rooted, drought-hardy legume with immense soil-restorative and nitrogen-fixing capabilities.
pigeonpeas.water_req: 600 - 800 mm (Deep roots make it highly drought-resistant)
pigeonpeas.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: DAP 50 kg/acre + Gypsum 80 kg/acre (supplies vital sulfur and calcium).
pigeonpeas.organic_boost: Rhizobium culture seed treatment + 3 tons vermicompost per acre.
pigeonpeas.common_diseases: Wilt (Fusarium udum), Sterility Mosaic Disease, Pod Fly.
pigeonpeas.disease_remedy: Grow wilt-resistant varieties; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (0.3 ml/L) for pod borer/fly.

mothbeans.name: Moth Bean (Vigna aconitifolia)
mothbeans.desc: The most drought-resistant legume in existence, thriving in desert soils and preventing soil erosion.
mothbeans.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: Single Super Phosphate (SSP) 100 kg/acre. No top-dressing required.
mothbeans.organic_boost: FYM 2 tons/acre applied 3 weeks prior to monsoon sowing.
mothbeans.disease_remedy: Neem oil spray (3%) against whitefly vectors; treat seeds with Thiram (2 g/kg).

mungbean.name: Mung Bean / Green Gram (Vigna radiata)
mungbean.desc: A short-duration (60-70 days) high-protein crop that fits easily into diverse crop rotation cycles.
mungbean.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: DAP 40 kg/acre. Foliar spray of 2% DAP or Urea at pre-flowering stage for bumper yield.
mungbean.organic_boost: Seed inoculation with Rhizobium + PSB; foliar spray of Panchagavya (3%).
mungbean.common_diseases: Mungbean Yellow Mosaic Virus (MYMV), Powdery Mildew, Cercospora Leaf Spot.
mungbean.disease_remedy: Spray Hexaconazole (1 ml/L) for powdery mildew; spray Thiamethoxam 25 WG (0.25 g/L) for whiteflies.

blackgram.name: Black Gram / Urad (Vigna mungo)
blackgram.desc: Rich in phosphoric acid and protein, black gram thrives on fertile loams and clay soils.
blackgram.growing_season: Kharif and Summer/Rabi in southern zones
blackgram.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: DAP 45 kg/acre + Sulphur 10 kg/acre. Foliar spray of 1% KNO3 during pod filling.
blackgram.common_diseases: Yellow Mosaic, Leaf Crinkle, Root Rot.
blackgram.disease_remedy: Seed treatment with Carbendazim (2 g/kg); maintain optimum drainage.

lentil.name: Lentil / Masoor (Lens culinaris)
lentil.desc: One of the earliest domesticated crops, renowned for high iron, protein, and dietary fiber content.
lentil.water_req: 250 - 400 mm (Low, utilizes residual soil moisture well)
lentil.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: SSP 120 kg/acre + Urea 15 kg/acre as starter nitrogen.
lentil.disease_remedy: Foliar spray of Propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L) upon early detection of rust.

pomegranate.name: Pomegranate (Punica granatum)
pomegranate.desc: A commercial perennial fruit known for antioxidant-rich arils, resilient in arid and semi-arid conditions.
pomegranate.water_req: 600 - 800 mm (Requires regulated deficit drip irrigation during bahar treatment)
pomegranate.growing_season: Perennial (Hashta, Mrig, or Ambe Bahar flowering)
pomegranate.fertilizer_recipe: Per tree/year: 250 g N, 125 g P2O5, 250 g K2O + 20 kg FYM + 2 kg Neem cake.
pomegranate.organic_boost: Apply 5 kg Vermicompost + 50 g Trichoderma per plant basin every 6 months.
pomegranate.common_diseases: Bacterial Blight / Telya (Xanthomonas axonopodis), Anthracnose, Fruit Borer.
pomegranate.disease_remedy: Streptocycline (0.5 g/L) + Copper Oxychloride (2.5 g/L) spray for bacterial blight.

banana.name: Banana (Musa acuminata)
banana.desc: A high-value, fast-growing fruit crop with very high nutritional and potassium requirements.
banana.growing_season: Year-round planting in tropical and sub-tropical zones
banana.fertilizer_recipe: Per plant: 200 g Urea, 250 g SSP, 300 g MOP split across 6 fertigation schedules.
banana.organic_boost: Apply 15 kg FYM + 1 kg Neem cake + 25 g VAM per pit at planting time.
banana.common_diseases: Panama Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum), Sigatoka Leaf Spot, Banana Weevil.
banana.disease_remedy: Use tissue-culture healthy suckers; spray Propiconazole (1 ml/L) for Sigatoka.

mango.name: Mango (Mangifera indica)
mango.desc: The most celebrated tropical fruit, thriving on deep, well-drained loamy soils with distinct dry periods for flowering.
mango.water_req: 700 - 1000 mm (Needs dry spell during flowering; regular watering during fruit development)
mango.growing_season: Perennial (Flowering in winter, harvest in summer)
mango.fertilizer_recipe: For 10+ yr tree: 1 kg Urea, 1.5 kg SSP, 1 kg MOP + 50 kg FYM applied post-harvest (August-Sept).
mango.organic_boost: Foliar spray of 1% Micronutrient Grade-IV before panicle emergence.
mango.common_diseases: Powdery Mildew, Anthracnose, Mango Hopper, Fruit Fly.
mango.disease_remedy: Wettable Sulfur (2 g/L) for powdery mildew; install Methyl Eugenol pheromone traps for fruit flies.

grapes.name: Grapes (Vitis vinifera)
grapes.desc: High-value fruit vine cultivated on trellises, demanding precision nutrition and canopy management.
grapes.growing_season: Perennial (Foundation pruning in April, Fruit pruning in October)
grapes.fertilizer_recipe: Apply water-soluble fertilizers (19:19:19, 0:52:34, 0:0:50) through drip based on growth stages.
grapes.organic_boost: Magnesium Sulphate (20 kg/acre) + Boron (2 kg/acre) + Humic acid soil drenches.
grapes.common_diseases: Downy Mildew (Plasmopara viticola), Powdery Mildew, Anthracnose, Flea Beetle.
grapes.disease_remedy: Bordeaux mixture (1%) or Metalaxyl-Mancozeb (2 g/L) for downy mildew prevention.

watermelon.name: Watermelon (Citrullus lanatus)
watermelon.desc: A warm-season crop rich in lycopene and hydration, ideal for sandy loams and riverbeds.
watermelon.water_req: 400 - 600 mm (Frequent light irrigations, reduce watering near harvest to increase sugar content)
watermelon.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: DAP 50 kg/acre + MOP 40 kg/acre. Top dress Urea or apply 13:0:45 via drip during fruiting.
watermelon.organic_boost: FYM 8 tons/acre + Wood ash for natural potassium supplement.
watermelon.common_diseases: Downy Mildew, Fusarium Wilt, Fruit Fly, Red Pumpkin Beetle.
watermelon.disease_remedy: Mulching to prevent fruit rotting; spray Cypermethrin (1 ml/L) for early beetle control.

muskmelon.name: Muskmelon / Cantaloupe (Cucumis melo)
muskmelon.desc: A sweet, aromatic melon requiring sunny, warm days and low humidity for optimal fruit sugar concentration.
muskmelon.water_req: 350 - 500 mm (Avoid water contact with fruit surface)
muskmelon.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: NPK 12:32:16 (60 kg/acre). Foliar spray of Calcium Nitrate (5 g/L) to prevent fruit cracking.
muskmelon.organic_boost: 5 tons Vermicompost + Seaweed extract spray at flowering.
muskmelon.common_diseases: Powdery Mildew, Gummy Stem Blight, Aphids.
muskmelon.disease_remedy: Spray Dinocap (1 ml/L) for powdery mildew; use yellow sticky traps for sucking pest monitoring.

apple.name: Apple (Malus domestica)
apple.desc: The premier temperate fruit, requiring specific winter chilling hours (800-1200 hrs < 7°C) for flower bud break.
apple.fertilizer_recipe: Per bearing tree: 700 g Urea, 1.2 kg SSP, 750 g MOP applied before bud break in spring.
apple.organic_boost: Calcium Chloride spray (0.5%) in late summer to prevent Bitter Pit physiological disorder.
apple.common_diseases: Apple Scab (Venturia inaequalis), Powdery Mildew, San Jose Scale.
apple.disease_remedy: Dodine (1 g/L) or Captan (2 g/L) sprays for apple scab at green-tip to petal-fall stages.

orange.name: Orange / Mandarin Citrus (Citrus sinensis / reticulata)
orange.desc: High-demand citrus requiring well-aerated soils and balanced micronutrients (Zinc, Iron, Manganese, Boron).
orange.water_req: 800 - 1200 mm (Sensitive to salinity and stagnant water)
orange.fertilizer_recipe: Per adult tree: 600 g Urea, 800 g SSP, 500 g MOP + 25 kg FYM split in two doses.
orange.organic_boost: Foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate (0.5%) + Ferrous Sulphate (0.4%) + Lime (0.25%).
orange.common_diseases: Citrus Canker (Xanthomonas), Gummosis (Phytophthora), Citrus Psylla, Leaf Miner.
orange.disease_remedy: Prune canker twigs; spray Streptocycline (100 ppm) + Copper Oxychloride (0.3%).

papaya.name: Papaya (Carica papaya)
papaya.desc: An herbaceous fast-growing fruit tree that bears fruit within 9-10 months of transplanting.
papaya.water_req: 1200 - 1600 mm (Highly prone to collar rot if water accumulates around the stem)
papaya.growing_season: Year-round in warm tropical and frost-free climates
papaya.fertilizer_recipe: Per plant/year: 250 g Urea, 300 g SSP, 250 g MOP divided into bi-monthly applications.
papaya.organic_boost: 10 kg FYM + 1 kg Neem cake per planting pit; maintain raised bed planting.
papaya.common_diseases: Papaya Ring Spot Virus (PRSV), Anthracnose, Foot Rot / Damping Off.
papaya.disease_remedy: Drench base with Metalaxyl-Mancozeb (2 g/L) against foot rot; manage aphid vectors.

coconut.name: Coconut (Cocos nucifera)
coconut.desc: A versatile perennial coastal palm, highly demanding in potassium, chloride, and steady sunshine.
coconut.water_req: 1300 - 2000 mm (Needs well-drained sandy/alluvial soil with steady water table)
coconut.fertilizer_recipe: Per palm/year: 1.3 kg Urea, 2.0 kg Single Super Phosphate, 2.0 kg MOP + 1.0 kg Common Salt (NaCl).
coconut.organic_boost: 50 kg FYM or green manure crops (sunn hemp) grown in basin and incorporated.
coconut.common_diseases: Bud Rot (Phytophthora meadii), Root Wilt, Rhinoceros Beetle, Red Palm Weevil.
coconut.disease_remedy: Place 1% Bordeaux paste in crown for bud rot; place pheromone traps for red palm weevil.

cotton.name: Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum)
cotton.desc: Known as White Gold, cotton is the premier natural fiber crop, thriving in deep black clay (Regur) soils.
cotton.water_req: 650 - 900 mm (Moisture stress at boll development reduces yield drastically)
cotton.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: DAP 60 kg/acre + MOP 30 kg/acre. Top dress Urea in 3 splits + Boron foliar spray (0.1%).
cotton.organic_boost: Incorporate 4 tons FYM + 250 kg Castor cake per acre.
cotton.common_diseases: Bollworms (Pink / American), Cotton Leaf Curl Virus, Bacterial Blight.
cotton.disease_remedy: Install PB-Rope pheromone dispensers for Pink Bollworm; spray Profenofos 50 EC (2 ml/L).

jute.name: Jute / Golden Fiber (Corchorus olitorius)
jute.desc: A 100% biodegradable natural bast fiber crop, thriving in warm, humid river basins and alluvial soils.
jute.water_req: 1200 - 1500 mm (Tolerates temporary flooding in later growth stages)
jute.fertilizer_recipe: Basal: NPK 10:26:26 (50 kg/acre). Top dress Urea (30 kg/acre) at 3rd and 6th week after sowing.
jute.organic_boost: Sunn hemp green manuring + Azotobacter seed treatment.
jute.common_diseases: Stem Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina), Seedling Blight, Yellow Mite.
jute.disease_remedy: Treat seed with Carbendazim (2 g/kg); spray Fenazaquin 10 EC (1.5 ml/L) for yellow mites.

coffee.name: Coffee (Coffea arabica / robusta)
coffee.desc: Highland shade-grown crop requiring rich volcanic or organic forest loams with slightly acidic pH.
coffee.water_req: 1500 - 2000 mm (Requires blossom showers in March-April and backing showers in May)
coffee.fertilizer_recipe: Apply NPK 17:17:17 in pre-monsoon and post-monsoon splits (150 kg/acre/year).
coffee.organic_boost: 10 tons forest compost + Rock Phosphate (100 kg/acre) + Dolomite for soil acidity control.
coffee.common_diseases: Coffee Leaf Rust (Hemileia vastatrix), Black Rot, Coffee Berry Borer.
coffee.disease_remedy: Spray 0.5% Bordeaux mixture before monsoon; install berry borer brocap traps.
